attributes.morphology: large stripe-like martensitic plates with hair-like stripes

evidence.quote: The martensitic structure of Ni53+xMn25Ga21.9/C0xGd0.1 alloys is not changed due to the change of Ni composition.

Fig. 3 a displays the TEM bright ﬁeld image of martensite in the Ni 53Mn25Ga21.9Gd0.1 alloy. It can be seen that the bright ﬁeld images exhibit large stripe-like martensitic plates with several microns in width, and the hair-like stripes can also be seen in the big plates.
When the Ni content is 58 at.%, the microstructure consists of two phases, including tetragonal-structured martensite and fcc c phase.

attributes.morphology: irregular second phase embedded in the plate-like martensite
